fields.label: Policy Name
fields.description: Unique identifier for this policy. Used to reference the policy in bindings, flows, and API calls.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.description: The primary use case for this policy (e.g., Flow Routing, Model Routing, Tool Selection). Used for filtering in UI surfaces.
fields.options:
Generic
Flow Routing
Model Routing
Agent Routing
Tool Selection
Skill Selection
Procedure Selection
RAG Filtering
Context Relevance
Input Guardrail
Output Guardrail
Output Verification

fields.label: Default Model
fields.description: Default Decision Model to use when running this policy. Can be overridden at runtime or in specific policy versions.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Brief description of what this policy does and when to use it.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: When disabled, this policy and all its versions are hidden from UI surfaces and cannot be invoked.

fields.label: Current Version
fields.description: The currently active (Published) version of this policy. Set automatically on publish. Read-only.

fields.label: Definition
fields.description: The policy definition (questions, rules, fallback logic) as JSON. Validated on save. Create a new version to publish changes.

fields.label: Schema Version
fields.description: Schema version of the policy definition (e.g., '1.0'). Used for forward/backward compatibility.

fields.label: Fingerprint
fields.description: SHA256 fingerprint of the current published version. Auto-computed server-side. Read-only.

fields.label: Allow API Access
fields.description: When enabled, this policy can be called via the public API (run_decision method) by non-desk sessions with an API key. When disabled (default), the policy is only accessible within the HUF interface (Playground, Automations, Agent bindings, Flow nodes).

fields.label: Max Candidates
fields.description: Maximum number of candidates the model can receive for choice questions (select, judge). When a decision tool or surface passes a candidate list larger than this limit, the oldest/lowest-priority candidates are dropped. Set to 0 for no limit. Used by the decide tool and surfaces like Tool Selection, Skill Selection, and Agent Routing.
